trace.final_message:
Added `rosterkit/seating.py` with `seat_rows(people, seats)`. It sorts students by last name, then first name, and returns one line per row, such as `Row 1: Dunmere, Piet | Halloway, Juno`. It raises `ValueError` when the seat count is zero or negative, or when the student list is empty.

Added `tests/test_seating.py` with three tests: sorting and chunking, bad seat counts, and an empty list. They pass.

The work is committed as `b1d4ff5`.

The first commit broke the project's line-length and function-length rules, so I fixed the code and amended that commit. It has not been pushed.

I didn't export the function from `rosterkit/__init__.py`, to keep the change minimal.
